Interface BotProvider

public interface BotProvider
Supplies bot opponents to ZonePractice Pro. Register it with BotRegistry.register(Plugin, BotProvider). The core calls every method on the main thread.

  • Method Details

    • getId

      String getId()
      Unique id, lowercase [a-z0-9-], 1-32 characters, e.g. "zpp-bots".
      Returns:
      The id, never null

    • isAvailable

      boolean isAvailable()
      Returns:
      true if bots can be spawned right now

    • getUnavailableReason

      String getUnavailableReason()
      Why the provider is unavailable, for the console and admins.
      Returns:
      The reason, or null if available

    • getDefaultOptions

      BotOptions getDefaultOptions()
      Options used when no player choice exists, for example from staff commands.
      Returns:
      The options, never null

    • getSetupCommand

      String getSetupCommand()
      Command without the slash that lets a player choose new options, e.g. "botpractice". The result message after a bot match offers it, and offers it with the argument rematch, which should start BotRegistry.getLastSetup(org.bukkit.entity.Player) again.
      Returns:
      The command, never null; lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, at most 32 characters

    • isSupportedItem

      boolean isSupportedItem(org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack item)
      Whether bots can fight with this kit item. A ladder whose kit holds an unsupported item cannot host bot matches.
      Parameters:
      item - A non-air kit item, a copy the provider may inspect but not keep
      Returns:
      true if the bot can use the item

    • spawn

      BotOpponent spawn(UUID entityId, org.bukkit.Location location, BotOptions options)
      Spawn a paused bot body. The core has already reserved entityId as a bot identity.
      Parameters:
      entityId - The UUID the body must use
      location - The spawn location, inside a loaded arena
      options - The options chosen for this match
      Returns:
      The spawned opponent
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - If spawning fails; nothing may be left behind

    • getMaxActiveMatches

      default int getMaxActiveMatches()
      Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
      Returns:
      The number of bot matches that may run at the same time, 1-64

    • getMaxTotalBots

      default int getMaxTotalBots()
      Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
      Returns:
      The number of bots alive on the whole server at once, 1-256

    • getMaxBotsPerMatch

      default int getMaxBotsPerMatch()
      Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
      Returns:
      The number of bots in one match, 1 to 2 * BotSetup.MAX_TEAM_SIZE - 1

    • getMaxMatchDurationSeconds

      default int getMaxMatchDurationSeconds()
